heard: AI can help you write code faster. But when something changes, how do you know what happened, what it affects, and whether it's ready to ship? Meet Failsafe, a development companion that helps solo developers keep their work visible, understand potential risks, and maintain a record of important decisions. Setup starts in the console. Install the core logic skills, approve the request in VS Code, and the workspace is ready. With version 6.0.12, the console, monitor, and SRE views share a consistent visual experience. Change your theme, and your workspace follows. The information stays familiar, wherever you're working. Now imagine a small but important bug. A date validator accepts a day that doesn't exist. We document the issue, write a regression test, and see the failure for ourselves. Fixing the code is only part of the job. Failsafe helps surface the risks and governance requirements around a change, so the developer knows what still needs attention. The corrected validator passes its tests. We can inspect the difference, see the recorded decisions, and compare the result with what we intended to change. Every change has a story. What we set out to do, what we changed, what we checked, and what still needs review. Failsafe helps make that story easier to follow. Move faster without losing sight of the work. Failsafe. Build with AI. Know what changed.
